facts.fact: The Ministry of Communications and Digital Economy held a two-day West Coast Region forum promoting the National Digital Addressing Initiative, which it says seeks to establish a national digital addressing database; Brikama council's chairman urged communities to protect address poles.

systems.owner: Ministry of Communications and Digital Economy

GMB.note: Document does not mention the central bank or payments.
Document does not address consumer protection.
Document does not address cross-border payments.
Document is about digital addressing, not a national digital strategy.
Document does not address government payments to people.
Brikama council only expects to use addresses for property rates; no revenue record system is stated.
No survey figure on account ownership.
A sensitisation forum informs communities; no consultation on a named draft or policy is stated.
Document does not address retail payments.
Document does not address electronic payment of taxes or fees.
